top_choice_rationale: P005 recognises targeted protein degradation as a single achievement limited to the PROTAC and induced-proximity strand. The principle is new and can be tested quantitatively through ternary-complex cooperativity, a crystal structure of the induced complex, and degradation kinetics, and many independent groups have reproduced it for over two decades. Crews and Deshaies conceived and first demonstrated it, and Ciulli's structure-guided ligand design supplies the physical-chemical basis, which a mechanism-minded citation should rest on. It avoids merging the PROTAC and cereblon glue strands, which have different discoverers. The lack of an approved degrader drug is the main risk, so I rank the C-N coupling proposals close behind.
